content:
ajay: FYI onboarding CI is failing after the latest typegen regen; sample-app auth/backoff-tests.js are flaky.
maria: Which job?
ajay: CI job #4123. Failure snippet: 
```
FAIL auth/backoff-tests.js
  Expected 2 retries but got 0
  at Object.<anonymous> (tests/auth/backoff-tests.js:27:10)
```
tyler: That smells like a default retry policy change slipped into one SDK. Any regendiff?
ajay: publish-checker flagged a regen mismatch on ts-sdk and also a missing changelog entry for a semver-minor behavioral change.
sophia: Do we have the diff?
ajay: Regendiff shows example ordering and exported type ordering changed -> changed emitted types, which bumped semver. But the deeper issue: go-sdk accepted a retry-policy refactor in PR #330 that altered default backoff from exponential(2) to fixed(500ms). ts-sdk didn't follow so parity broke.
maria: Ouch. For new customers that use sample-app defaults, onboarding will break. We need parity ASAP.
tyler: Root cause looks like non-deterministic ordering in typegen examples; the regen reordered example blocks which ripples into runtime defaults for some generated clients. I can add deterministic sorting to the generator, plus a unit test to lock ordering.
sophia: Nice. Short-term options: 1) revert go-sdk change, 2) update ts-sdk to match go-sdk, 3) make sample-app explicitly set retryPolicy. Which is fastest?
ajay: Option 2 + manual changelog is fastest. But publishflow will block until changelog exists because this is a behavior change.
maria: I'll quick-patch sample-app to set an explicit retryPolicy to avoid flakiness in CI while SDK releases happen.
tyler: I'll open a codegen PR in ~10m to add stable sort and deterministic example hashing. That should reduce spurious regendiffs going forward.
sophia: I'll draft a changelog entry and coordinate the minor release for ts-sdk. Should we call it v0.13.0?
ajay: Yes, follow semver guidelines: behavior change -> minor bump.
tyler: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/codegen/pull/801 - stable sort + deterministic example hashing + regen test. Triggering regen on that branch now.
devex-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff detected for 'ts-sdk' (hash mismatch). Blocking files: generated/clients/types.ts.
maria: Local regen against codegen PR yields matching hash now. Pushing sample-app test patch (make retry assertion tolerant) to keep CI green if publish lags.
ajay: Who will do the ts-sdk release?
sophia: I'll handle the release and changelog. Draft note: "Align TypeScript SDK retry/backoff defaults with go-sdk to restore SDK parity and reduce onboarding flakiness." Add a reference to the sample-app test update.
maria: Sample-app test change: instead of asserting exact retry counts, assert final error message or read an exported retryCount field. That reduces brittleness. Pushed that change to branch onboarding-ci-fix.
tyler: CI rerun: job 4123 rerun started.
devex-bot: CI job 4123 rerun started.
devex-bot: publish-checker: regen-diff resolved on codegen branch.
tyler: With deterministic regen and ts-sdk update, publish-checker no longer blocks.
sophia: Publishing ts-sdk v0.13.0 now (includes retry default alignment + changelog entry).
ajay: After publish, update sample-app dependency and rerun onboarding suite.
devex-bot: npm publish: ts-sdk@0.13.0 successful.
maria: Upgraded sample-app to ts-sdk@0.13.0; onboarding tests are green.
tyler: Follow-ups: add regen unit test to CI, and add a lint rule to prevent accidental default policy changes without explicit changelog tagging.
sophia: Also adding a short devex note clarifying semver handling for behavioral changes and how to avoid sample-app breakage: explicitly set defaults in examples.
ajay: Thanks all, will document the incident in a short writeup.
maria: Closing thread, moving tasks to the devex board. :tada:
